entries.name: AsyLex – Legal Advice for Asylum Seekers
entries.description: If you are seeking protection in Switzerland and your housing situation is connected to an asylum or immigration matter, you may need specialist legal advice. AsyLex provides legal advice to people seeking protection in Switzerland, including assistance with asylum procedures and appeals. You can submit your situation and relevant documents through its online form. If you have a deadline in the next few days, clearly state this in your submission so that your request can be prioritised. AsyLex generally responds by email, usually within one working day. Do not wait for a response if an immediate legal deadline requires urgent action.

entries.name: Zürcher Beratungsstelle für Asylsuchende (ZBA) – HEKS and Caritas
entries.description: If you are an asylum seeker or provisionally admitted person living in the Canton of Zurich, and your housing situation is connected to your asylum status or immigration proceedings, you may benefit from specialist legal support. The ZBA provides free and independent advice on asylum procedures, legal options and dealings with public authorities. In appropriate cases, it may also provide legal representation. Please contact the service and explain any decisions, notices or deadlines you have received. Telephone counselling and open consultation have specific hours. If your deadline is imminent, explain this when contacting the service.
entries.eligibility_note: The service specifically identifies asylum seekers with status N and provisionally admitted persons with status F living in the Canton of Zurich.
entries.cost_note: The ZBA provides free and independent advice on asylum procedures, legal options and dealings with public authorities. In appropriate cases, it may also provide legal representation.
entries.opening_hours: Telephone counselling and open consultation have specific hours. If your deadline is imminent, explain this when contacting the service.

entries.name: Frauenzentrale Winterthur – Legal Advice
entries.description: If you need help understanding your legal position or deciding what steps to take in a housing dispute, you may wish to obtain independent legal advice. Frauenzentrale Winterthur offers legal consultations on several matters, including tenancy law, employment law, family law and social insurance. You can contact the organisation to arrange a confidential consultation with a legal adviser. The consultation costs CHF 90. A reduced fee may be possible in cases of financial hardship. The service does not take on court representation or prepare legal submissions, so if you face an imminent deadline or court proceeding, you should also seek appropriate legal representation.
entries.cost_note: The consultation costs CHF 90. A reduced fee may be possible in cases of financial hardship.

entries.name: Caritas Zürich – Social Counselling
entries.description: If your housing situation is becoming difficult because of financial hardship, family circumstances or other social problems, you may benefit from speaking with a social counsellor. Caritas Zürich provides support for people experiencing poverty and difficult personal circumstances. It can help you identify available assistance and understand where to seek further support. You can contact Caritas Zürich to explain your circumstances and ask what support may be available. Short telephone counselling is available at specific times. Please avoid sending confidential documents or sensitive personal information by ordinary email.
entries.opening_hours: Short telephone counselling is available at specific times. Please avoid sending confidential documents or sensitive personal information by ordinary email.

entries.name: Schuldenberatung Kanton Zürich
entries.description: If unpaid rent, outstanding bills or other debts are making it difficult to maintain your housing, professional debt counselling may help you assess your financial situation. Schuldenberatung Kanton Zürich provides advice to individuals experiencing debt and financial difficulties. Please contact the service to discuss your debts, income and expenses and ask about arranging a personal consultation. Telephone counselling is available Monday to Thursday, 10:00–13:00. Please note that the organisation has a waiting list for personal consultations, which can be several weeks. It does not provide loans or money to repay debts. If you have received a formal rent-arrears notice or termination notice, seek tenancy-law advice immediately as well. Do not wait for a debt-counselling appointment.
entries.opening_hours: Telephone counselling is available Monday to Thursday, 10:00–13:00.

entries.name: Pro Infirmis Zürich – Disability and Social Counselling
entries.description: If you have a disability and your housing situation is affecting your independence, safety or ability to manage everyday life, specialised social counselling may be helpful. Pro Infirmis Zürich provides free and confidential social counselling for people with disabilities and their relatives. It can provide information about support options relating to housing, independent living and participation in everyday life. Please contact the service and explain how your housing circumstances are affecting your needs and what assistance you may require. You can also ask about its social counselling services and accessibility arrangements.
entries.audience: people with disabilities and their relatives
entries.cost_note: Pro Infirmis Zürich provides free and confidential social counselling for people with disabilities and their relatives. It can provide information about support options relating to housing, independent living and participation in everyday life.

entries.name: Infodona – City of Zurich Advice Centre for Migrants
entries.description: If you are experiencing housing difficulties alongside migration, financial, family or other personal problems, you may benefit from speaking with a multilingual counselling service. Infodona provides information and counselling on legal, family, financial, employment and health-related questions. Counselling is available in several languages, including Arabic, English, French, Portuguese, Russian, Somali, Spanish, Tamil and Tigrinya. Please contact Infodona to arrange an appointment and explain the difficulties you are experiencing. Eligibility: This service is for people who live in the City of Zurich, rather than everyone living in the Canton of Zurich.
entries.audience: migrants living in the City of Zurich
entries.eligibility_note: This service is for people who live in the City of Zurich, rather than everyone living in the Canton of Zurich.

entries.name: Opferberatung Zürich – Victim Support
entries.description: If your housing situation involves violence, threats, abuse or another potentially criminal act, you may be entitled to confidential victim support. Opferberatung Zürich provides free and confidential counselling for people affected by physical, psychological or sexual violence, including domestic violence. The service can explain your rights, help you consider protective measures, connect you with legal and psychological professionals and help identify safe accommodation where necessary. You do not need to decide whether to report the incident to the police before asking for advice. If you are in immediate danger, contact the emergency services. You can also call 142 at any time for victim-support assistance.
entries.cost_note: Opferberatung Zürich provides free and confidential counselling for people affected by physical, psychological or sexual violence, including domestic violence.
entries.opening_hours: If you are in immediate danger, contact the emergency services. You can also call 142 at any time for victim-support assistance.

entries.name: BIF – Counselling Centre for Women against Violence in Relationships
entries.description: If you are experiencing violence, threats or controlling behaviour in a relationship or family situation, you may benefit from specialist support. BIF provides counselling for women affected by domestic violence and violence in relationships. You can discuss your circumstances confidentially and receive support in considering your safety, available protection and possible next steps. If you are in immediate danger, contact the police on 117 or emergency services as appropriate.

entries.name: Frauenberatung sexuelle Gewalt – Zurich
entries.description: If your housing or personal circumstances involve sexual violence, harassment or other forms of gender-based violence, specialist counselling may be available. Frauenberatung sexuelle Gewalt provides support for women affected by sexual, physical and psychological violence, including domestic violence. You can contact the service to discuss what happened, understand possible support options and receive assistance in identifying appropriate next steps. Counselling can be sought even if you are uncertain about reporting the incident.

entries.name: FIZ – Fachstelle Frauenhandel und Frauenmigration
entries.description: If your housing situation involves exploitation, trafficking, coercion or violence connected to your migration circumstances, you may need specialised and confidential support. FIZ supports migrant women affected by violence and exploitation, including people experiencing trafficking or abusive working and living conditions. It can provide counselling, support with accessing safe accommodation and referrals for legal, medical and psychological assistance. Its trafficking-protection programme supports affected people throughout Switzerland. Its counselling for migrant women is focused on people in the Canton of Zurich. You can contact FIZ even if you do not have valid residence documents. Its services are confidential and free, and it will not take action without your consent.
entries.eligibility_note: You can contact FIZ even if you do not have valid residence documents. Its services are confidential and free, and it will not take action without your consent.
entries.cost_note: You can contact FIZ even if you do not have valid residence documents. Its services are confidential and free, and it will not take action without your consent.

entries.name: fiera Opferberatung Winterthur
entries.description: If you are a woman affected by physical, psychological or sexual violence, including violence in a domestic setting, you may benefit from specialist victim counselling. fiera provides support to women affected by violence and can help you understand your rights, identify protection options and access further assistance. Please contact the service to discuss your circumstances and arrange counselling. If you are in immediate danger, contact the police on 117 or emergency medical services on 144.

entries.name: KOKON – Counselling for Children, Young People and Young Adults
entries.description: If a child or young person is experiencing violence, abuse, psychological distress or an unsafe family or housing situation, specialised support may be needed. KOKON provides crisis counselling and victim support for children, young people and young adults affected by physical, sexual or psychological violence. The service can help identify appropriate protection and support measures. If a child is in immediate danger, contact the police on 117 or emergency medical services on 144. For urgent support for children and young people, call 147.

entries.name: Brava – Support relating to Gender-Based Violence
entries.description: If someone close to you is experiencing gender-based violence, or you are supporting a person affected by violence, you may benefit from specialist advice on how to help safely. Brava provides counselling and information for relatives, friends and professionals supporting people affected by gender-based violence. The service can help you understand the situation, consider appropriate ways to offer support and identify specialist organisations in the person's region. Please contact Brava to confirm current availability and whether it can assist with your particular circumstances. This is principally a referral and support service for people around affected individuals and professionals; it should not replace direct victim-support services in an emergency.

entries.name: Selbsthilfe Zürich – Peer Support and Self-Help Groups
entries.description: If your housing difficulties are causing isolation, stress or emotional strain, connecting with people who have experienced similar challenges may provide additional support. Selbsthilfe Zürich helps people find self-help groups and peer-support networks in Zurich and surrounding areas. You can contact the organisation to discuss whether a suitable group exists or whether another form of support may be more appropriate. Peer support can complement professional legal, medical or social assistance, but does not replace it.

entries.name: Mieterinnen- und Mieterverband Zürich – Tenant Association
entries.description: If your situation involves a dispute with your landlord or questions about your tenancy agreement, you may benefit from specialist advice on Swiss tenancy law. The Mieterverband Zürich provides tenancy-related information and legal support for members dealing with issues such as rent increases, termination notices, defects in rented accommodation and disputes with landlords. Please contact the organisation to ask about membership, advice services and appointment availability. Please note that the telephone number above is for general and administrative enquiries, not legal advice. Legal advice for members is provided through the organisation's advice channels. A separate legal hotline for non-members is available at 0900 900 800 and costs CHF 4.40 per minute.
entries.cost_note: Please note that the telephone number above is for general and administrative enquiries, not legal advice. Legal advice for members is provided through the organisation's advice channels. A separate legal hotline for non-members is available at 0900 900 800 and costs CHF 4.40 per minute.

entries.name: Frauenzentrale Zürich – Legal Advice
entries.description: If your housing dispute overlaps with family, relationship, employment or other personal legal issues, you may benefit from an initial assessment by a legal adviser. Frauenzentrale Zürich provides legal consultations for women on a range of legal matters. You can arrange a consultation to discuss your circumstances and understand possible next steps. The consultation lasts one hour and costs CHF 90 for non-members or CHF 60 for members. This service does not replace specialist tenancy representation. If you have received a termination notice or face an imminent deadline, contact a tenancy-law specialist as well.
entries.cost_note: The consultation lasts one hour and costs CHF 90 for non-members or CHF 60 for members.

entries.name: Bezirksgericht Zürich – Legal Information on Tenancy Matters
entries.description: If you need information about tenancy procedures or the general legal framework for a housing dispute, the Zurich District Court provides a legal information service for tenancy matters. You can ask general questions about tenancy law and the conciliation or court process. In-person consultations take place on Wednesdays from 09:00–11:30. Telephone consultations take place on Mondays from 09:00–11:30 and 13:30–16:00, and Wednesdays from 13:30–16:00. The service is available only in German and is intended for people who rent or let property in the City of Zurich. It cannot provide advice where proceedings are already pending before the conciliation authority or tenancy court, or where the person is already represented by a lawyer. If you have an imminent deadline, do not wait for the next consultation session before seeking urgent legal advice.
entries.audience: tenants and landlords in the City of Zurich
entries.eligibility_note: The service is available only in German and is intended for people who rent or let property in the City of Zurich. It cannot provide advice where proceedings are already pending before the conciliation authority or tenancy court, or where the person is already represented by a lawyer.
entries.opening_hours: In-person consultations take place on Wednesdays from 09:00–11:30. Telephone consultations take place on Mondays from 09:00–11:30 and 13:30–16:00, and Wednesdays from 13:30–16:00.

entries.name: HEKS Zürich/Schaffhausen – Migration and Refugee Support
entries.description: If your housing situation is connected to migration, asylum, integration or difficulties dealing with public authorities, you may benefit from specialist support. HEKS provides migration and social-support services. In the Canton of Zurich, its work with Caritas includes the Zürcher Beratungsstelle für Asylsuchende (ZBA). If you are an asylum seeker with status N or a provisionally admitted person with status F living in Zurich, contact ZBA directly for advice on asylum-related legal issues. For other migration or social-support matters, contact HEKS to identify the appropriate regional service.
